primary_use_cases: Drop-in long-term memory for LLM apps via interceptor; SQL-backed persistence; optional graph for multi-hop queries
deployment_options: Self-hosted Python library; pip install memorable-ai; any SQL database (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Neon, Supabase)
pricing_summary: Free OSS; no managed tier yet
integration_model: Interceptor monkey-patches OpenAI, Anthropic, LiteLLM chat APIs — memory.enable() with zero app code changes. Manual async API for add/search also available.
storage_backends: SQLAlchemy SQL primary (memories + conversations); embeddings in JSON column; NetworkX in-process graph; optional Neo4j when MEMORABLE_GRAPH__CONNECTION_STRING is set (memorable_ai/graph/neo4j_backend.py)
memory_tiers: Documented working/short-term/long-term/episodic hierarchy; single memories table with importance_score, consolidation interval, and temporal validity columns — logical tiers not separate physical stores
graph_model: Optional NetworkX MultiDiGraph with entity/relationship heuristics; Neo4j backend for production; graph_enabled config flag
multi_tenant_model: Namespace on MemoryEngine; session_id on memories; IdentityResolver for alias linking (memorable_ai/core/identity.py)
extraction_approach: pattern | llm | hybrid via MEMORABLE_EXTRACTION__MODE; LiteLLM extraction in extract_with_llm; ConversationSummaryStore for rolling summary; pattern fallback for facts/preferences/skills/rules/context
update_operations: MemoryUpdater: ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP via LLM tool-call when not add_only; MEMORABLE_EXTRACTION__ADD_ONLY for Mem0 2026 ADD-only mode; consolidation invalidates contradictions
consolidation_strategy: Background asyncio loop (default 6h): importance scores, contradiction resolution via invalidate_memory with superseded_by_id
temporal_model: valid_from, valid_to, invalidated_at, superseded_by_id, confidence columns; TemporalMemory sets valid_from; active queries filter invalidated_at IS NULL
agent_fact_handling: LLM extraction prompt includes user and assistant facts; hybrid mode merges pattern + LLM extractions
retrieval_signals: Multi-signal fusion: semantic (MiniLM) + SQL LIKE + BM25 (bm25.py) + entity overlap (entities.py) + optional graph; weights configurable via RetrievalConfig
reranking: Weighted fusion in HybridRetriever; no cross-encoder reranker yet
latency_profile: Measurable via benchmarks/comparison/compare_systems.py; full LOCOMO leaderboard not published
token_efficiency: Selective retrieval vs full-context; per-query token tracking not yet in CI
multimodal_support: Plugin SDK stub (memorable_ai/multimodal/base.py); TextFilePlugin for plain text files
connectors: Connector plugin SDK stub (memorable_ai/connectors/base.py); no bundled Notion/Slack connectors yet
procedural_memory: Rule and skill memory types via pattern + LLM extraction
framework_integrations: OpenAI/Anthropic/LiteLLM interceptor; LangChain MemorableCallbackHandler; optional Mem0Adapter; AutoGen memory hook helper; CrewAI memory helper
locomo_scores: Smoke fixture measured via benchmarks/locomo/test_data.py and pytest test_locomo_smoke; full snap-research/LOCOMO dataset not integrated
benchmark_methodology: LOCOMO smoke + measured latency in compare_systems.py; see docs/benchmarks.md for targets vs measured
stated_unsolved_problems: Full LOCOMO/LongMemEval/BEAM leaderboard scores; cross-tenant user profiles; bundled SaaS connectors; full multimodal ingest; episodic-to-semantic rollup at scale
public_roadmap: ROADMAP.md — full LOCOMO dataset, LongMemEval, enterprise dashboard, published paper
known_limitations: Alpha; LLM pipeline requires API keys; Neo4j optional extra; marketing targets in README not yet validated on full benchmarks
memorable_has: Interceptor + SQL + hybrid modes + LLM/pattern extraction + ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP + BM25/entity retrieval + temporal validity + Neo4j option + LangChain/Mem0 adapter + unit tests + competitive research artifact
memorable_lacks: Published LOCOMO vs Mem0 91.6; LongMemEval; user profiles; production multimodal; bundled connectors; cross-encoder reranker
priority_for_memorable: P1 — full LOCOMO dataset integration and published benchmark comparison
